# Slashr

> Slashr (slashr.dev) is a multi-chain validator risk-intelligence product by NullRabbit. It tracks validator slashing, delinquency (downtime), jailing, and commission events across Solana, Ethereum, Sui, and Cosmos, and scores every validator 0–100 with the Slashr Risk Index.

Slashr helps stakers, delegators, staking operators, and risk/treasury teams see which validators put stake at risk. Chain data is collected continuously and surfaced three ways: a live incident feed, a per-validator risk score (the Slashr Risk Index), and cross-chain reliability reports.

The Slashr Risk Index is the public inverse of an internal validator health grade: a transparent 0–100 composite of downtime, slashing history, commission behavior, and infrastructure health. Higher score = higher risk.

## Core surfaces

- [Slashr Risk Index](https://slashr.dev/risk): Every tracked validator ranked 0–100 by risk, with stake at risk, incident trend, and slashing count.
- [Live incident feed](https://slashr.dev/feed): Slashing, downtime, and commission events across every network, as they happen.
- [Validator directory](https://slashr.dev/validators): All validators with recorded incidents, searchable by network.
- [Rankings](https://slashr.dev/rankings): Worst offenders and most reliable validators by network and period.
- [Reliability reports](https://slashr.dev/reports): Cross-chain reliability summaries per staking provider.
- [Check your validators](https://slashr.dev/check): Paste a wallet address to see the incident history and risk of the validators it delegates to.

## Feeds (machine-readable)

- RSS 2.0: https://slashr.dev/feed/incidents.rss
- JSON Feed 1.1: https://slashr.dev/feed/incidents.json

## For developers and AI agents

- [Developers](https://slashr.dev/developers): REST API and MCP server documentation.
- MCP server (streamable HTTP): `https://mcp.slashr.dev/mcp`. Tools: get_validator_incidents, get_validator_stats, get_scan_results, get_worst_offenders, check_delegation, get_network_summary.
- REST API and full docs: https://slashr.dev/developers and https://docs.slashr.dev

## About

- Built by [NullRabbit](https://nullrabbit.ai).
- Networks currently public: Solana, Ethereum, Sui, Cosmos.
- On X: https://x.com/SlashrDev
